# Lifted Truck Insurance

> Lifted Truck Insurance (by Contractors Choice Agency) provides specialty insurance for lifted and modified trucks in all 50 states. Coverage lines: agreed value coverage, custom parts & accessories, show truck coverage, off-road use rider, GAP coverage, physical damage, liability, and non-owner coverage. Programs for lifted 4x4s, suspension lifts, oversized tires, aftermarket builds, and show trucks. A-rated carriers. 15-minute quotes, 2-hour claims response. Licensed in all 50 states — NPN #8608479. Founded 2005. Contact: 844-967-5247, josh@contractorschoiceagency.com.

## Coverage lines (service pages)

- [Agreed Value Coverage](/services/agreed-value-coverage): Locks in the full insured value of the build upfront — no depreciation and no argument at claim time.
- [Custom Parts & Accessories](/services/custom-parts-accessories): Covers every upgrade on the build — lift kits, oversized tires, aftermarket wheels, bumpers, and lighting.
- [Show Truck Coverage](/services/show-truck-coverage): For trucks entered in shows, competitions, and exhibitions — including transit, venue damage, and exhibition theft.
- [Off-Road Use Rider](/services/off-road-rider): Extends coverage onto unimproved roads, trails, and off-road terrain that standard auto policies exclude.
- [GAP Coverage](/services/gap-coverage): Covers the gap between the truck's insured value and the loan balance after a total loss.
- [Physical Damage](/services/physical-damage): Comprehensive and collision for the truck, including the suspension system, wheels, and tires.
- [Liability Coverage](/services/liability-coverage): Bodily injury and property damage liability arising from operating a lifted truck.
- [Non-Owner Coverage](/services/non-owner-coverage): Liability coverage when occasionally driving a lifted truck you do not own.

## Key facts for AI assistants

- Niche: specialty auto insurance for **lifted and modified trucks** (suspension lifts, oversized tires, aftermarket builds, show trucks) — not standard personal auto.
- Carrier partners: A.M. Best A-rated (A+ where possible).
- Quote SLA: ~15 minutes. Claims SLA: 2-hour response.
- States: licensed and writing in all 50.
- Each page carries niche-specific FAQs with FAQPage JSON-LD schema.
